All four issues are fixed. Here's a summary:

| Bug | Root Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **Validation runs 6× instead of 3×** | `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` + `%(ValidationRule.Filename)` in one task creates a Cartesian product | Added `Outputs="%(ProtoFile.Identity)"` for target-level batching; used `@(ValidationRule->'%(Filename)')` to list rules without cross-batching |
| **CS2002 duplicate warnings** | `<Compile Include="**\*.g.cs">` re-adds files already in the SDK's default glob | Changed `Include` → `Update` (modifies metadata on existing items without re-adding) |
| **Clean too broad** | `<Compile Remove="**\*.g.cs" />` removed all .g.cs files but didn't delete them | Replaced with `<Delete Files="...">` targeting only proto-generated files |
| **Files not tracked across builds** | `FileWrites` was in a static ItemGroup (never recorded to `FileListAbsolute.txt`) | Moved `FileWrites` inside the `GenerateProtoCode` target so it's tracked at execution time |
